messages:
Tasha: Quick pass on compare table in compact mode — a few things that tripped users in today's demo.
Tasha: 1) Pin state isn't announced by screen readers; `aria-current` would help but not sufficient for the pin control itself.
Tasha: 2) The performance badges use two axes (latency vs cost) but we only show a color and tiny icon. people misinterpret green = cheap.
Riley: Re: 1) I suggest `button[aria-pressed]` for the pin + a live region update when pins change: '2 models pinned for compare'.
Riley: Re: 2) Could we add a tiny shape modifier per tier (circle/triangle/square) so colorblind users get an extra cue?
Marco: For compact rows we don't have room for full text. Idea: always include a short aria-label on the badge like "Performance: latency-first; P95 <50ms" and on hover/focus show microcopy.
Marco: Also saw a visual jitter when toggling density: pin icon shifts for a frame. moving pin to absolute position inside row container should fix it.
DesignOps: Microcopy proposal for tooltip title/body: "Performance — Latency-first" / "Measured P95 latency on reference harness. Not indicative of cost." Link: "How we measure". Keep it under 120 chars.
Tasha: Good. Also: when filters collapse on narrow screens the filter state disappears visually. users think filters cleared. Proposal: show collapsed pill with counter "Filters (2)" and keep it tabbable.
Riley: Implementation note: collapsed toggle should have `aria-expanded` and an accessible name including the count when closed: `Expand filters, 2 selected`. Use aria-live to announce when collapsed/expanded.
Marco: Quick code sample for badge:
```
<Badge
  variant="performance"
  aria-label={`Performance: ${tier}; ${metricText}`}
  data-shape={tierShape}
/>
```

Marco: and for pin button:
```
<button aria-pressed={isPinned} aria-label={`Pin ${model} v${ver} for compare`}>
  <Icon name="pin" />
</button>
```

DesignOps: Also recommend a small legend icon in the table header that opens an inline popover (not full modal) containing definitions and unit examples (latency P95 in ms, throughput rps, cost per 1k tokens). Track clicks on it.
Tasha: Analytics: `catalog.legend.open` with { view: 'compare', density: 'compact' }. send as strings.
Riley: Edge case: if many rows are pinned (>4) the banner gets long. collapse into a pill "4 pinned" that expands on click to list the models. ensure it is reachable by keyboard and announce changes.
Tasha: Perf badge contrast: small-size icons at 12px fall under WCAG. We need contrast >= 4.5:1 for text/icon color. If not possible, add a subtle halo/outline in neutral-700.
a11y-bot: Quick checks to include in PR: 1) Pin control must have aria-pressed + accessible name. 2) Live region announces pin and filter changes. 3) Badge must have aria-label and non-color visual cue. 4) Collapsed filter toggle must include selected count in accessible name. 5) All new interactive elements keyboard-focusable and testable.
Marco: I'll prototype the shape variants + absolute pin layout and open a small PR.
DesignOps: I'll craft the tooltip/popover copy and Figma mock; will include the analytics hook.
Tasha: We'll aim to ship as incremental UX fixes; no backend changes. Hold for a short cross-team review before merge.
Riley: Sounds good. I'll add quick Cypress a11y smoke tests for these flows.
Tasha: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short note to support & docs if wording changes land.
